searchMicrobenchmark.boundary: Go only, immutable shared-ref synthetic history; excludes OCCT, artifact I/O/unmarshal/unpack, HTTP and browser; 3 iterations per case, one run, not P95
searchMicrobenchmark.recipe: each step adds 2 new faces, carries all previous UNCHANGED records, and modifies/deletes the anchor every 9 steps; generated supports are not identity continuation
searchMicrobenchmark.comparison: ResolveGrowingHistory includes first index construction plus query in current, full scan in baseline. IndexedQueryGrowingHistory builds the index outside timing; it is a separate reuse boundary, not the first-query comparison.

routerWriterAndViewValidation.boundary: normal Workspace Service through production Router and real Worker; one serial recipe run per variant, independent generated business identities. Before is intermediate current-turn implementation AFTER native prefix fixes and indexed search, BEFORE native-value writer memoization and 128 MiB parsed-view admission. This is not a whole-HEAD service comparison.
routerWriterAndViewValidation.correctness: one-stage appends and tip edit; exact expected volume; three old source face references resolve; wrong target manifest digest rejected; Undo/Redo; cold BREP/NAMING equivalence; Head unchanged by cold preview; cross-build replay of the earlier stored 242-feature document retains exact BREP/NAMING bytes
routerWriterAndViewValidation.parsedViewCharging: encodedBytes*16 plus metadata; conservative admission estimate, not process RSS or a measured decoded-size upper bound; oversized views share the in-flight load but are not retained
routerWriterAndViewValidation.reproduce: mise run check --scope services --level integration --match 'TestGrowingTopologyPartFeaturesAndNamingThroughRouter|TestStoredGrowingTopologyNamingReplayThroughRouter' --test-jobs 1 --jobs 4; optional stored replay requires OCCCCAD_TEST_NAMING_REPLAY_DOCUMENT referencing a frozen prior-build development document

limitations: No remote 10 MB B-pillar input, CATIA comparison, GPU timing, P95 or industrial-capacity conclusion.
Native and service timings are different boundaries; service before/after covers only the second part of this turn.

Full v2 transition rows, evidence and historical outputs are preserved. With growing topology, explicit unchanged lineage storage remains proportional to the sum of tip sizes. Chunk/delta persistence and incremental Revision model storage remain design directions.

Common pipeline savings apply wherever the shared result/encoder/resolver contract is used; exact Boolean/loft/fillet algorithms still need feature-specific measurements. This fixture does not measure every feature type.
Cache budgets do not bound OCCT/allocator/process memory or active reader leases.
